title: Additivity of normalized degree-one Proj chart fractions
statement: For a scheme S, a quasi-coherent graded affine-basis algebra A, an affine open U, and a,b in A(U)_1, the normalized sections a/1 and b/1 of the degree-one Proj twist satisfy (a+b)/1 = a/1 + b/1.

source.place: Tag 01NR, homogeneous fraction formula in the proof of lemma-glue-relative-proj-twists

proof.text: Evaluate the three sections at a point of the chart. The normalized unitToTwist evaluation gives the localization fractions (a+b)/1, a/1 and b/1. Additivity in the localization identifies the first with the sum of the latter two; pointwise extensionality proves equality of sections.

theorem twistChartFraction_add (U : S.affineOpens) (a b : A.grading U 1) :
    A.twistChartFraction U (a + b) =
      A.twistChartFraction U a + A.twistChartFraction U b
